summary: One church. Both November issues print the same schedule box (Sat 9:00 AM & 4:30 PM, Sun 8:30 & 10:30 AM, weekdays 8:15 AM, Sat confession 3:30-4:00 PM), confirmed by the intentions; the website is partly stale (8:00 weekday Mass, chapel 8-7). Open: whether the Adoration Chapel is at the church (Mon-Sat 8:15 AM-4 PM) and how to record its Sunday hours.
